Title: Manoj's Day

Cast

1. Manoj - 35 years, prince, son
Look: golden crown, red royal robe
2. Sanjay - 60 years, king, father
Look: golden crown, red royal robe

Places

1. The training ground - an earth ground, a rack of weapons
2. The fields - a wheat crop, a neem tree

Scene 1: The training ground - Day

[Manoj stands on the training ground. Sanjay stands near him.]

Sanjay: "What lovely weather!"

[Manoj mounts his horse and gallops away.]

Manoj: "I knew it!"

[Manoj swings his sword from the saddle of his horse.]

Manoj: "Let's see."

Scene 2: The fields - Day

[Manoj stands in the fields. Sanjay stands near him.]

Sanjay: "So, here we are!"

[A cobra bites Manoj and he dies in the fields.]

Sanjay: "No… this cannot be!"
